pale-lemon.$description: Pale Lemon — Primary action fill, brand accent, hero section wash, badge labels — the single chromatic voice of the entire system

electric-yellow.$description: Electric Yellow — Yellow outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Page canvas, card surfaces, text on light fills, hairline dividers, image borders — the base everything floats on

paper.$description: Paper — Primary text on dark, card surface alt, heading strokes, inverted button text

graphite.$description: Graphite — Muted heading strokes, de-emphasized outline text, secondary borders on dark

mist.$description: Mist — Body subtext, link idle state, tertiary metadata — the only neutral that softens body copy without going silver

steel.$description: Steel — Captions, helper text, dense metadata rows, low-emphasis body

pp-neue-montreal.$description: Primary face across body, navigation, subheadings, and display. The custom geometric grotesque carries the entire brand voice: tight tracking at display sizes (up to -4.8px at 120px) compresses headlines into editorial-poster blocks, while relaxed tracking at body keeps 16px reading clean. Single weight 400 used throughout — weight does not differentiate hierarchy; size and color do.

pp-neue-montreal-medium.$description: Navigation and select body emphasis at the 16px size — the only place a medium weight appears, used to give nav links a subtle lift over body text without breaking the single-weight visual rhythm

abc-monument-grotesk.$description: Alternate display face for the largest hero statement — a wider, more architectural grotesque that provides a second editorial voice at maximum scale without competing with PP Neue Montreal elsewhere

system-sans-serif.$description: Micro labels, copyright, legal footnotes — the only size at which the system stack appears, keeping fine print neutral and invisible
